commits: 368c505b2c7f3e0c24c7d2d4b6a46a5679b3e033 fix(cli): modelpipe ollama takes --allow-private-backend, and a backend refused as not local names it
impl_reports.summary:
E3 is done as one commit on the E2 base. It is unpushed and has no trailers. The author is Matt O'Grady <sewing.wader8c@icloud.com>.

Files changed (all under /Users/mattogrady/.local/src/worktrees/modelpipe/lane-mp2/modelpipe):
- modelpipe-cli/src/cli.rs: `OllamaArgs` gains `--allow-private-backend`, with the same help text as serve's flag, plus `#[expect(clippy::struct_excessive_bools, reason = "a flag surface")]`. `into_serve` now passes `self.allow_private_backend` where it used to hard-code `false`.
- modelpipe-cli/src/serve_out.rs: new `pub(crate) fn not_served(e: ServeError, allowed_private: bool) -> anyhow::Error`.
  - When the error is `BackendNotLocal` and the flag was not passed, it keeps the library's message and appends: ". If the backend is on a private (RFC 1918 or ULA) address on your own network, pass --allow-private-backend; a link-local or public address is refused either way".
  - Every other case returns `e.into()`, the same conversion `?` did before. The module doc names the new function.
- modelpipe-cli/src/serve_cmd.rs: the `modelpipe::serve(...)` result now goes through `.map_err(|e| not_served(e, allow_private_backend))?`, so serve and ollama both get the hint.
- modelpipe-cli/src/main_tests.rs: two new tests.
  - `ollama_takes_allow_private_backend_and_hands_it_to_serve`
  - `a_backend_refused_as_not_local_names_the_flag_only_when_it_was_not_passed`: covers not-local without the flag (hint present, library text first), not-local with the flag (unchanged), and `InvalidBackendUrl` (unchanged).
- modelpipe-cli/tests/serve_ticket.rs:
  - A helper `ollama(backend, extra, name)`.
  - The e2e `ollama_refuses_a_private_backend_and_names_the_flag_that_permits_it` (192.168.1.5: exits with failure, empty stdout, stderr has the library text and the flag).
  - A negative control, `ollama_given_the_flag_refuses_a_link_local_backend_without_naming_it` (169.254.169.254 with the flag: refused, flag not named).
  - The module header's "Each test costs the ten seconds" became "A run that gets as far as a listener costs the ten seconds…; a run refused before that does not wait". The new refusal tests end before the relay wait, so the old sentence was no longer true.
- README.md: the `--allow-private-backend` row (the `RFC 1918` grep) adds "`modelpipe ollama` takes it too; without it, the error for a backend refused as not local names it."

I ran the binary by hand. The refusal reads: "Error: backend http://192.168.1.5:11434 is not a local address — modelpipe exposes your own server, not the network behind it. If the backend is on a private (RFC 1918 or ULA) address on your own network, pass --allow-private-backend; a link-local or public address is refused either way". `modelpipe ollama --help` lists the flag.

The commit body argues `fix(cli)`, with each claim checked against the tree:
- `ollama` shipped in 0.8.0 without the flag (`git show v0.8.0:modelpipe-cli/src/cli.rs` has `allow_private_backend: false` in `into_serve`).
- ADR 0003 admits a private backend only with the operator's say-so, and at the command line that say-so is this flag.
- `serve`, in the same modelpipe-cli at the same workspace version (0.8.0), takes it.

Commands run: see commands_run below. Full mutation results: see mutations below.

impl_reports.summary:
I fixed both defects and folded them into the PR's only commit. The old head was 368c505 and the new one is 973e231, with the same subject and parent 80833a3. Nothing was pushed. Compared with 368c505, only two files changed: modelpipe-cli/src/main_tests.rs (+17/-3) and modelpipe-cli/tests/serve_ticket.rs (+4/-4). modelpipe-cli/src/serve_out.rs is unchanged; the code was already correct, and only the test was too weak.

Defect 1. The test `a_backend_refused_as_not_local_names_the_flag_only_when_it_was_not_passed` now makes three new checks. With the flag passed, the not-local refusal must still downcast to `ServeError` (main_tests.rs:539). A `ServeError::Bind(io::Error::other("port in use"))` must come back as `ServeError` (main_tests.rs:552). Its `{:#}` output must still contain "port in use" (main_tests.rs:553). The cause text lives only in `source()`: `Bind`'s Display is the fixed string "could not set up the p2p listener" (modelpipe/src/serve_error.rs:229) and the io error is its source (serve_error.rs:254). So line 553 checks that the error chain survives, not just the message. The test's doc comment says this. Mutation R10 now fails the test.

Defect 2. The module header at serve_ticket.rs:23-26 now reads "Every run says `--no-state`, names a `--state-dir` under the temp directory, or is given a `HOME` of its own there, so …". I read it back at 973e231 and checked every run in the file against it. `serve()` and `serve_unread()` pass --no-state; so does `a_generated_token_that_was_printed_draws_no_notice`. The state and lock tests use `at(home(..))`. `ollama_offers_a_first_code_and_keeps_its_state` and the new `ollama()` helper pass `--state-dir` under `std::env::temp_dir()`, and each run's folder name is distinct.

Commit body. I rewrote only the "Tests:" paragraph so it names the new check: "…and that a refusal with the flag passed and a failed bind come back as the library's own error, the bind's cause included." It is wrapped at 72, I read it back at the new hash, and the other paragraphs are byte-identical.

impl_reports.review_focus:
1. The new test doc sentence (main_tests.rs:520-523): "`Bind`'s text says what failed and only its source says why, so an error re-made from the text would lose the why". Check it against serve_error.rs:229 and :254 at this commit.

defects.what: The pass-through half of `a_backend_refused_as_not_local_names_the_flag_only_when_it_was_not_passed` cannot tell the library's own error from a copy re-typed as a string. It compares only `to_string()`, and only on `InvalidBackendUrl`, which has no source. Mutation R10 changes `e.into()` to `anyhow::anyhow!("{e}")`, which drops the typed `ServeError` and its `source()` chain. R10 SURVIVED the whole `cargo test -p modelpipe-cli --no-fail-fast` run (70 unit + 12 e2e, all green). The code is correct today, but three places claim more than the test checks: the rustdoc at serve_out.rs:141 ("Every other error, and this one with the flag passed, is the library's own"), the commit body ("the library's error is returned as it was") and the author's report ("the same conversion `?` did before"). The regression this leaves open is a real one. Before this commit, `?` kept the chain by construction. Now one function sits on the path, and a later edit to it could flatten `Bind`/`Identity` so that `Caused by: <OS error>` (the only place the operator learns why the key file or the listener failed) vanishes, with every test still green.
defects.fix: In that test, add a case with a source-carrying variant and check that it is still the library's own error with its chain intact. For example: `let bind = not_served(ServeError::Bind(std::io::Error::other("port in use")), false); assert!(bind.downcast_ref::<ServeError>().is_some(), "{bind:#}"); assert!(format!("{bind:#}").contains("port in use"), "{bind:#}");`. Also add `assert!(not_served(not_local(), true).downcast_ref::<ServeError>().is_some());` for the flag-passed case. Then re-run R10 (`e.into()` becomes `anyhow::anyhow!("{e}")` in serve_out.rs) against `cargo test -p modelpipe-cli --bin modelpipe main_tests`, confirm it goes red, and restore by rewriting the bytes and touching the file.

defects.what: The header says "Every run either says `--no-state` or is given a `HOME` of its own under the temp directory". The new `ollama()` helper does neither: it passes `--state-dir <temp>` with the developer's real HOME. So the two tests this commit adds are both runs the sentence misdescribes. The sentence was already false at the base for `ollama_offers_a_first_code_and_keeps_its_state`, but this commit adds two more such runs and leaves it standing. It also rewrote the paragraph just above it ("Each test costs the ten seconds") for exactly this reason: a new test made it untrue. The bolded claim itself (nothing touches the real data directory) still holds, because an explicit `--state-dir` means `state::data_dir()` is never consulted. Only the stated mechanism is wrong.
defects.fix: Reword lines 23-24 so they are true for every run in the file. For example: "Every run says `--no-state`, names a `--state-dir` under the temp directory, or is given a `HOME` of its own there, so a test never reads a developer's identity…". Read it back at the new hash.
